description: Call this tool to replace {{placeholders}} in a .docx and write a new file, reporting what was filled, unfilled or ignored. Call it with no values to list them. Free: templates up to 10 placeholders.

docx_base64.description: The .docx template itself, base64-encoded, instead of uploading it first

out_path.description: Where to write the filled .docx. Defaults to <template>-filled.docx

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

template_path.description: Name of a template uploaded with doc_upload

values.description: Placeholder name to value, e.g. {client: "Acme", fee: "EUR 4,500.00"}

name: doc_fill_template
title: Fill a Word template
